notes: Forward-compatible application schema 113 to 114. Migrations through 113 are immutable applied production history. Migration 114 adds a service-role-only, invoker-rights public-site runtime context RPC. The application retains its complete existing site resolution path only while this RPC is absent during the guarded post-acceptance migration window. A verified schema-113 backup is required before migration; recovery is forward-repair-only after schema advances beyond 113.
